## Why version control is useful

1. It records changes with informative commit messages, so we can understand how and why a project developed.
2. It lets us compare versions and recover earlier work when a change introduces a mistake.
3. It supports collaboration through branches and merging, allowing people to contribute to the same project.

## A simple calculation

This R code chunk calculates one plus one and shows the result.

```{r addition}
1 + 1
```
